Custom blinds, shades, shutters and drapery

Compare Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments, fabrics and finishes. We’ll help you choose for light and privacy, then measure for a custom fit.

Blinds

Adjustable slats give you everyday control over daylight and privacy. Compare wood, metal and vertical blinds to find the right finish and function for your room.

Explore blinds

Shades

Explore roller, solar, cellular, Roman, woven wood and sheer shades. Fabric and lining choices help you balance natural light, privacy and room darkening.

Explore shades

Shutters

Give your windows a finished, architectural look. We’ll help you consider the material, finish, louver size and panel arrangement for your windows and doors.

Explore shutters

Drapery

Add softness, texture and a fabric you love. Custom drapery and sheer panels can stand on their own or layer with blinds and shades for more flexibility.

Explore drapery

John got his start installing window treatments before opening his California store in 1995. That experience still shapes the advice we give in our Woodland Hills showroom.

Schedule a visit to see fabrics and finishes, compare window treatments and talk through your rooms. We’ll help you narrow down the options for light, privacy and the way you want your home to feel.

Motorized shades and PowerView automation

Open a room to the morning light or lower several shades together. Motorized window treatments make daily adjustments easier, especially at tall or hard-to-reach windows.

We offer Hunter Douglas PowerView and Somfy motorization, including compatible hub setup. We’ll help you choose the right controls and show you how to use them.

  • Handheld remotes and wall controls
  • App control on compatible systems
  • Group control for multiple shades
Explore motorized shades

Window treatment measuring, installation and repairs

Choosing the treatment is one part of the project. We also handle the measuring, installation and practical questions along the way.

Consultation & measuring

Tell us about your rooms, your budget and what you want to change. We’ll compare options and take the measurements needed to prepare your quote.

Professional installation

We install your window treatments, check their operation and walk you through the controls. You’ll know how to use them before we finish.

Blind & shade repair

Send us photos and a description of the problem. We’ll review the product, condition and parts availability to help determine whether repair is practical.

Commercial window treatments

For offices, restaurants and other commercial spaces, we help select window coverings around glare, privacy, daily use and the way the space needs to work.

Custom upholstery for your furniture

A favorite chair, a well-made sofa or a piece that fits just right can be worth keeping. Our upholstery service starts with a conversation about your furniture and budget.

We bring fabric samples, take measurements and photos, and work with an upholstery specialist to prepare a quote. You can weigh the options before deciding what comes next.

Window treatment questions

Have a question about your own windows? Call us at (818) 884-5464.

How do I choose between blinds, shades and shutters?

Start with how you use the room. Blinds offer adjustable slats, shades offer a wide range of fabrics and light control, and shutters provide adjustable louvers in a framed panel. We’ll compare the options with your privacy needs, windows and budget in mind.

Can you help with privacy and room darkening?

Yes. We can compare fabrics, opacity, linings and layering options. Daytime and nighttime privacy can differ, particularly with solar and sheer fabrics. The product, fit and light around its edges all affect how dark a room will feel.

Can I add motorization to my existing shades?

It depends on the shade and its components. Send us the brand, model if available, and photos so we can review the options. Motorization is also available with compatible new window treatments.

Do you repair blinds and shades from other brands?

We can evaluate some other brands. Repair depends on the construction, condition and whether parts are available. Photos are a helpful first step. We’ll let you know whether a repair or replacement is the more practical choice.

What affects the cost of custom window treatments?

Window dimensions, product style, material, fabric, lining, controls and installation requirements all influence the quote. Share your priorities and budget early so we can help you compare suitable options.

Which areas of Los Angeles do you serve?

We’re based in Woodland Hills and serve customers across the San Fernando Valley and parts of greater Los Angeles, including Calabasas, Beverly Hills, Malibu and Santa Monica. Contact us with your ZIP code to discuss your project.
